Subject: Put your post on the calendar
Preview text: Review threads, mentions, and media before choosing when it should publish.

Choose when your post goes live

Hi there,

Start with Typefully’s post preview before you schedule. Typefully is a social media scheduler, and its preview lets you check threads, mentions, and media before a post goes live.

Use that check to confirm the post you’re about to place on your calendar. You can see what’s scheduled, in review, and ready to ship.

Once the preview looks right, choose one specific publication date and time for the post, then schedule it in Typefully. That gives the post a clear place on your calendar and completes the scheduling step.

Schedule in Typefully → https://typefully.com/

emails.subject_strategy: Signal that the draft is ready for its next concrete step and foreground scheduling, without implying urgency, guaranteed results, or a recommended best time.

directions: Produce exactly one English activation email.
Keep the email body under 150 words, excluding subject, preview, and signature.
Ask for one action only: schedule the finished draft for a specific date and time.
Use the documented preview as the first step and explain why it helps this reader.
Use one CTA linked to https://typefully.com/.
avoid: Unsupported plan, access, timing, or outcome claims
context_only: The reader’s social account is already connected.

brief.voice_notes: Match Typefully’s compact, energetic style. Use direct second person and make scheduling feel like the natural next move. A light emoji is optional, not required.

reasons: No persisted market recommendation applies to this campaign.
